title: bromus agrarius subsp. diffusus
intro: Bromus agrarius subsp. diffusus, commonly known as the hairy chess, is a subspecies of the annual grass Bromus agrarius. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Asian cultures, for its medicinal properties. The plant is believed to have health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of Bromus agrarius subsp. diffusus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
